name: polarion-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Polarion ALM REST API, with an optional HTTP wrapper for Custom GPTs.
author: Phillip Bösger

scripts.build: rm -rf build && tsc && chmod 755 build/index.js build/http-server.js
scripts.build:http: rm -rf build && tsc && chmod 755 build/http-server.js && cp build/http-server.js build/index.js
scripts.test: rm -rf build-tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-tests/tests/*.test.js
scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('tsconfig.json') && fs.existsSync('src') && fs.existsSync('node_modules/.bin/tsc')) require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.generate-tools: node scripts/generate-tools.mjs .gen/src/index.ts src/tools.ts && node scripts/enrich-tool-metadata.mjs && node scripts/enrich-output-schemas.mjs
scripts.regenerate: npm run download-spec && npm run fix-sparse-fields && npm run generate-mcp && npm run generate-tools && npm run build && npm test
